basic_info.description: Truly an oasis in the heart of Mission Dolores, this adorable, standalone 1906 cottage condo couldn't be more charming. Something this special doesn't come around in the City very often. Tucked at the back of the lot, this 1-bed, 1-bath cottage with 1-car garage parking beckons as you walk past the lemon trees in the secluded front courtyard. Once inside, the cozy living room with a freestanding gas fireplace makes you feel right at home and opens up to an updated eat-in kitchen with a skylight and butcher block countertops. Hang out with friends, grill dinner, and enjoy the exclusive-use back yard under the market lights before heading out to enjoy the nightlife in the neighborhood. Then retire in the ample bedroom with high ceilings and a skylight. The recently-renovated bathroom with gleaming tile and a clawfoot tub exemplify the blend of old- and new-world San Francisco. With in-unit stacked laundry, a renovated attic perfect for storage, TV watching, or working from home, and proximity to the best Mission Dolores has to offer, this condo checks the boxes!
